snippet.title: BPM: Bitcrushed Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
The next game from BPM: Bullets Per Minute creators Awe Interactive is BPM: Bitcrushed. It's a pixellated roguelite rhythm shooter where you can battle to the beat of your own imported music. It's coming to PC and consoles in 2026

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #bpmbitcrushed #gamescom
